en: Junessic Land, Isle's End...

Yeah!
Yes.
...Y-Yes.

Wh-When we were attacked by that{SAUT}carnivore, you went along with the vote{SAUT}that time...{PAGE}And... this isn't any different... right?
Back off the guy! What're you all{SAUT}baggin' on him for, anyways!?
I can't believe this... There's no way{SAUT}this is how they should handle their{SAUT}problems.

Yeah, let's hurry up and stop them―he's{SAUT}about to get kicked outta the herd!
I agree with Joker―let's jump in and{SAUT}put a stop to this!

If you're so adamant on not being{SAUT}kicked out, then prove that you're{SAUT}really on our side here!

If you want to rejoin our herd, you have{SAUT}to prove that you fit in with us!

Hey, keep it together―don't just make{SAUT}yourself agree with them!
No... I don't wanna be abandoned...{PAGE}I didn't do anything wrong! It's―{SAUT}It's all because you humans went and{SAUT}stuck your stupid noses into this!
